text:
olivia: quick heads-up — ran a quick set of bench runs for 40B quant (q4f16) across h100/apac and a100/eu to validate dedicated pool sizing. saw weird p99 spike during warmup on h100-apac. posting numbers.
rahul: thanks. can you paste the raw p50/p95/p99 and concurrency config? curious if it's warmup-only or sustained.
olivia: paste below (single-run snapshots):
```
model: redwood-40b-q4f16
seq: 1024
batch: 1
concurrency_per_gpu: 6
h100-apac: p50 82ms, p95 160ms, p99 342ms
a100-eu:   p50 95ms, p95 175ms, p99 390ms
notes: h100 p99 spikes within first 60s of steady traffic, then drops ~30% after cache warms
```
sam: hmm, h100 being faster p50 but spike at p99 during warmup suggests KV warmup or kernel selection thrash. what kernels did you use? fused attention or fallback math kernels?
olivia: default runtime picks fused for h100, but we saw fallback on some sequences (deploy-bot flagged kernel-mismatch). included deploy-bot log in thread.
deploy-bot: kernel-select: fused_attn_v2 -> fallback_math for ~12% requests during warmup window (gpu 2). reason: dropout pattern & sequence padding mismatch.
jess: interesting. if fallback is happening under concurrency load, that could blow up tail latency. two levers: increase per-GPU concurrency to amortize kernel switch overhead, or pre-warm KV cache & pinned slot tiling to avoid fallback paths.
rahul: what are target SLOs here? we need concrete sizing recs for Dedicated runbook.
olivia: product wants p99 <= 300ms for interactive features. current runs breach that on h100 apac early.
sam: my quick calc: with concurrency 6 we get these per-gpu qps ~ 6*(1/avg_latency). but tail dominated by fallback 342ms. If we cap concurrency to 4 and add pre-warm slots (10% of pool) we reduce contention and kernel thrash.
infra-bot: recent autoscale policy logs show median surge headroom configured at 20%. night surges in APAC have hit 1.6x baseline historically.
rahul: proposal: for Dedicated APAC H100 pool (40B q4f16)
- target per-gpu concurrency: 4
- pre-warm slot fraction: 10% pinned (warm KV, run warmup ops at rollout)
- autoscale buffer: 35% (to cover tail and regional surge)
- monitor: kernel-fallback-rate and p99 1min windows for first 5min of traffic
sam: +1 but add canary rollouts with traffic ramp over 5 mins and forced warmups (run 2 warmup requests per slot) on deploy.
jess: operational note: slot-tiling change needed — set tile_size to 128 to align seq padding and minimize fallback math triggers.
olivia: ok i'll update the capacity worksheet with this plan and run another pass with concurrency=4 and tile_size=128, pre-warm enabled. will post bench results tomorrow.
rahul: also log: if p99 still > 300ms after these changes we should consider adding one extra GPU per pool (3->4) as stopgap for QPS headroom.
olivia: noted. thanks all. will loop back with numbers. :thumbsup:
